treaty_name: Convention between the Kingdom of Norway and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital gains (2013)
eif_quote: Avtalens ikrafttredelsesdato 17-12-2013 | Art. 32(2): The Convention shall enter into force on the date of the later of these notifications and shall thereupon have effect: a) in Norway: (i) in respect of taxes on income relating to the calendar year ... next following that in which the Convention enters into force ... b) in the United Kingdom: (i) in respect of income tax and capital gains tax, for any year of assessment beginning on or after 6th April next following ...
source_title: GOV.UK synthesised text of the MLI and the 2013 UK-Norway Double Taxation Convention (in force); cross-checked with Lovdata traktat 2013-03-14-6

rates.quote: b) shall, notwithstanding the provisions of sub-paragraph a), be exempt from tax in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident if the beneficial owner of the dividends is: (i) a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State and owns, directly or indirectly, at least 10 per cent of the capital in the company paying the dividends;

a) may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends;
1.Interest arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.
1.Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of [the Convention], a benefit under [the Convention] shall not be granted in respect of an item of income if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of [the Convention]. [Synthesised text: replaces paragraph 7 of Article 10, paragraph 5 of Article 11, paragraph 5 of Article 12 and paragraph 5 of Article 20; 'In the United Kingdom and Norway, for taxes withheld at source, from 1 January 2020']

notes: Dividends Art. 10(2)(b)(ii): exemption also for a pension scheme; Art. 10(3): government (Norges Bank, GPFG, Bank of England, state bodies) exempt. valid_from 2014-01-01 is the Norwegian effective date; in the UK the convention has effect for income tax from 6 April 2014 and corporation tax from 1 April 2014. MLI art. 8 does not apply (UK reserved art. 8(3)(a)). Replaced the 2000 convention.
